title: observability-crds
description: The CustomResourceDefinitions this stack depends on, owned as their own release. Strict: an unknown key fails the render rather than being silently ignored, because a misspelled set name would leave a set installed that the consumer believed they had turned off.

sets.description: Which CRD sets this release installs. All false is refused at render.

victoriaMetrics.description: The VictoriaMetrics operator's CRDs, from upstream's own CRDs chart.

grafanaOperator.description: The grafana-operator's thirteen grafana.integreatly.org kinds. Off by default: nothing installs them until a cluster enables the operator (charts/observability-cluster).

envoyGateway.description: Envoy Gateway's SecurityPolicy CRD only, the kind charts/observability-stack renders for tenancy.authz. Off by default: Envoy Gateway's own release owns the CRD; turn this on only where it does not.

externalSecrets.description: External Secrets Operator's ExternalSecret and SSHKey CRDs only, the kinds charts/observability-stack renders for tenancy.authz.signingKey.source eso. Off by default: the operator's own release owns them; turn this on only where it does not.

vmoc.description: Passed through to the vendored victoria-metrics-operator-crds chart. Upstream's surface, not this chart's, so it is not constrained here.
